name: Daniel Morgan Oates
alt: Portrait of Daniel Morgan Oates outdoors, smiling, in a blue jacket and tartan scarf
bio: With more than 30 years’ professional experience, Dan is a true master of his craft. His passion for landscaping shows in every aspect of his work.
With 16 RHS medals to his name, including gold at the Chelsea Flower Show, and a commitment to customer service that has earned him an excellent reputation with clients.

name: Ania Pawlowska
alt: Portrait of Ania Pawlowska wearing glasses, beside orange orchid flowers
bio: Ania has loved gardens and nature since childhood. She grew up in the countryside, where her parents kept livestock and a small vegetable plot, and trained as a landscape architect, with a master’s degree from the University of Warmia and Mazury in Poland. Scholarships in Hungary, Portugal and Ukraine taught her how differently each culture gardens, and England’s garden tradition drew her here.

She joined Morgan Oates in 2013 as maintenance team leader, moved up to maintenance manager, and is now our garden designer, leading garden design and soft landscaping. She has worked on site on Chelsea Flower Show designs, and her design was chosen as one of five best show garden designs for APL at BBC Gardeners’ World Live 2019.

name: Stefan
alt: Stefan the dog resting on the stone path of a finished London garden, with a bronze-glazed planter in the foreground
bio: Stefan has no plans, no tools and no opinions on planting schemes, but he keeps a close eye on the finished work. Here he is testing a new path.
